ns2:course.label: Org Design and Environment
ns2:course.description: Understanding of complex organizations; particular attention to ways of dividing work, achieving coordination, and issues connected with change and adaptation. Prerequisite: BADM 310.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Curric Unassigned or Accountancy or Finance or Marketing or Information Sys & Info Tech or Supply Chain Management or Business Process Management or Management major(s). Restricted to students with Junior or Senior class standing.
